record.original_question: Solve d-bar with Lp estimates, 1 < p < ∞ for smooth convex domains in C^n . 6.4 Uniform estimates for d-bar on pseudoconvex domains ¯ = f in sup norm on smooth bounded

evidence.quote: Problem 6.3.2 Solve ∂¯ with Lp estimates, 1 < p < ∞ for smooth convex domains in Cn . 6.4 Uniform estimates for ∂¯ on pseudoconvex domains ¯ = f in sup norm on smooth bounded

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ be a smooth bounded convex domain. For $1<p<\infty$ and a $\bar\partial$-closed $(0,q)$-form $f$ with coefficients in $L^p(\Omega)$ (where $1\le q\le n$), construct a linear solution operator $T_q$ producing a $(0,q-1)$-form $u=T_q f$ satisfying $\bar\partial u=f$ together with the estimate
$$\|T_q f\|_{L^p(\Omega)} \le C_{p,\Omega}\,\|f\|_{L^p(\Omega)},$$
where the constant $C_{p,\Omega}$ depends only on $p$ and $\Omega$. Equivalently: prove $L^p$-boundedness, for every $1<p<\infty$, of a solution operator to the Cauchy–Riemann equation $\bar\partial u=f$ on every smooth bounded convex domain in $\mathbb{C}^n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Optimal $L^p$ and Hölder estimates for $\bar\partial$ have been established on smooth bounded convex domains of finite type (work of Diederich–Fischer–Fornæss, Alexandre, Cumenge, and others). For general smooth bounded convex domains (without a finite-type assumption, allowing infinite-type boundary points) the full $L^p$ result for all $1<p<\infty$ does not appear to be completely settled in the literature; only partial results are available. The problem is therefore considered partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Extremal Bases and Hölder Estimates for ∂̄ on Convex Domains of Finite Type
status_evidence.snippet: Optimal Hölder and Lp-estimates for the ∂̄-equation have been proved on smooth convex domains of finite type.
status_evidence.claim: Lp estimates for dbar are known on smooth convex domains of finite type.

status_evidence.title: On Lp Estimates of the Cauchy–Riemann Equation
status_evidence.snippet: Lp estimates have been obtained for solving operators of the Cauchy–Riemann equation on pseudoconvex domains of finite type.
status_evidence.claim: Partial Lp results on finite-type pseudoconvex/convex domains.

status_evidence.title: Weighted Lp estimates for ∂̄ on a convex domain with piecewise smooth boundary in C^2
status_evidence.snippet: Weighted Lp estimates (1≤p<∞) for ∂̄ on convex domains with piecewise smooth boundaries in C^2.
status_evidence.claim: Special cases in C^2 are known.
